command:
import json, hashlib, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'nuvem'))
from benchmark import solver_bridge as bridge, scoring
from benchmark.runner import evaluate_project
from benchmark.extract.from_solver import project_from_solver
m=bridge.engine();out=[]
for stage,short in [('main','tgd'),('n1f','tgd'),('main','tp1'),('n1f','tp1')]:
 path=root/('docs/checkpoints/evidence/beta-'+stage+'-'+short+'.json')
 s=json.loads(path.read_text())
 source=root/'nuvem/benchmark/projects'/s['project']
 data=json.loads((source/'input.json').read_text())
 assert hashlib.sha256((source/'input.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==s['input_sha256']
 nodes,walls,ends,openings=bridge.plan_from_input(data)
 catalog,_,_=bridge.catalog_from_input(data)
 for c in s['candidates']:
  for k in ('origin_world','x_dir','y_dir'):c[k]=m.XYZ(*c[k])
 rows={int(ci):[s['candidates'][i] for i in row['candidates']] for ci,row in s['physical'].items()}
 result={'course_candidates':rows}
 base=bridge._ft((data.get('settings') or {}).get('base_z_cm') or 0)
 project=project_from_solver(s['project'],result,walls,nodes,openings,catalog,base,len(rows))
 reference=json.loads((source/'reference.json').read_text())
 findings,score,comparison=evaluate_project(project,reference)
 baseline=json.loads((source/'baseline.json').read_text())
 delta=scoring.compare_runs(baseline,score)
 existing=json.loads((source/'score.json').read_text())
 same=score['findings_by_code']==existing['findings_by_code'] if stage=='n1f' else None
 item={'stage':stage,'project':s['project'],'source_head':s['head'],'snapshot_sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'input_sha256':s['input_sha256'],'reference_sha256':hashlib.sha256((source/'reference.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'baseline_sha256':hashlib.sha256((source/'baseline.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'score':score,'baseline_delta':delta,'candidate_replay_matches_versioned_findings_by_code':same}
 out.append(item)
 print(json.dumps({'stage':stage,'project':short,'critical_regressions':[r for r in delta['critical'] if r['status']==scoring.STATUS_CRITICAL_REGRESSION],'category_regressions':[r for r in delta['categories'] if r['status']==scoring.STATUS_REGRESSED],'candidate_replay_matches':same,'validator_errors':score['validator_errors']}))
payload={'head':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'scope':'Reconstruct benchmark geometry from immutable physical census and official plan; rerun current unchanged validators/reference, not a fresh solver execution. Solver-signal metadata intentionally absent; does not feed findings. Candidate counts cross-checked against existing N1f score.','results':out}
with (root/'docs/checkpoints/evidence/beta-baseline-replay.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump(payload,f,indent=2)
assert all(r['candidate_replay_matches_versioned_findings_by_code'] is not False for r in out)
